stages.focus: Play the opening mission and learn the basics.
notes: First trophy of the run; it pops when Gone Fishing ends.
stages.title: Prologue — Gone Fishing

stages.focus: Finish the chapter; grab the one possibly missable moment.
notes: Breakfast Run is the chapter's named-mission trophy.
stages.title: Chapter 1
stages.warning: MISSABLE WATCH: after the mission Down to Earth, accept Lucia's meditation invitation at Jason's house (morning, balcony) before leaving Chapter 1 — the invitation becomes unavailable afterwards, and whether it is required for Positive Mental Attitude is still unconfirmed.

stages.focus: The Cartel Heist and Child's Play; open the money systems.
notes: Garage purchases open via the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver.
The Scooter Bros app unlocks via the mission Moses — start registering cheap stolen cars for On the Spot.
stages.title: Chapter 2

stages.focus: Headliners and VCIA Takedown; unlock the quiet robbery tools.
notes: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun for Sneakthief.
Chapter 3 progress opens Standard Tracker registration at Pay 'n' Spray.
stages.title: Chapter 3

stages.focus: Operation Savage Glory; unlock the big bank vaults.
notes: The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks large bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.
stages.title: Chapter 4
stages.warning: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4 — the final mission follows soon after.

stages.focus: Complete the final mission and open free-roam cleanup.
notes: After the credits, the 100% Completion checklist opens at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
stages.title: Final mission

stages.focus: Stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the big counts — then 100% completion, then the platinum.
notes: Big counts: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone races, 20 races, 18 meditation spots, 100 WAiNK scans, 50 challenges (70 of 80 for 100%), 100 vehicles discovered (200 of 277 scanned for 100%), 52 areas, 9 gangs (all 39 operations for 100%), 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 500 Criminal Profile actions.
100% completion also needs: 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 large bank vaults, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Strangers & Freaks needs 8 qualifying strands — Andy, Billy and Tyrone do NOT count.
A Long Road (100%) is usually the last trophy before the platinum pops.
stages.title: Cleanup — collectibles, counts & 100%
stages.warning: Watch tier: Retail Therapy (keep the pursuit alive between shops), Sneakthief (one alarm fails the run) and Actions Speak Louder (long opaque count) — save before each attempt.

rules: One playthrough is enough; free-roam continues after the story.
No mission replay — keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave).
Cheats disable trophies and saving for the session — keep them off until the platinum pops.
No online trophies; the whole set is single-player and offline.
No gold medals are needed for story missions.
summary.time_estimate: About 200 hours (KeenGamer, PowerPyx) — Push Square warns it can pass 300 hours; both are rough ranges, not promises

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
